newsitem.title: USA: Vermont plans to crack down on welfare fraud.
newsitem.headline: Vermont plans to crack down on welfare fraud.

text.p: Bennington and Windham counties in southern Vermont are the targets of a crackdown on welfare fraud even though the problem amounts to less than five percent of welfare rolls, a state official said.
Welfare Commissioner Jane Kitchell said the program will reduce fraud even more and free up money for ongoing welfare reform efforts.
State police officers will participate by tracking down and verifying information provided by welfare recipients.
